issue.description:
Final gate for umbrella beadrs-b526004b: walk all four of its acceptance items against the final committed state and record the evidence so the umbrella can close on inspection instead of failing a tenth time.

Acceptance:
- Binary at final location: pinned-binaries/bead-attempt-resolution-f25ab5c exists, is executable, and runs (--version prints 'bead 0.2.6 (f25ab5c-dirty ...)') - per acceptance item 1
- Metadata alongside the binary: .metadata.json contains git commit SHA (f25ab5c91c09a3408f23b9cdf2f3e95e81abc060), binary sha256 (9a8455f25bacf5bc961bd740442fdc1b30a67fb6e38d304c23c97a57cf57b04e), build date, and feature flags - per acceptance item 2
- Executable from final location: capabilities subcommand runs from the pinned path - per acceptance item 3
- Pin location documented: README.md names the directory and versioned filenames, and those docs are committed to main (child 3 landed them) - per acceptance item 4
- Append the evidence (paths, hashes, doc sections, commands run and their outputs) to this bead's notes at close; note the one known informational discrepancy (63c2ee8's commit message cites b0d7840, a SHA that exists nowhere - authoritative value is f25ab5c)

If any item fails, record exactly which and why in notes before closing or releasing - do not silently pass.

63c2ee8 "feat(pinned-binaries): pin HEAD attempt-resolution binary at b0d7840" cites b0d7840 as the pin SHA and a "b0d7840-dirty" version string. The task text called that SHA one that "exists nowhere"; as of HEAD dfe9c6d that premise is stale: b0d7840f6c96cd45e16ea05b7babdb42ef0d2654 EXISTS, is an ancestor of main (restored by merge b057d2768a859270b2d9e8855f1467bfb3521a84, 2026-09-02 15:20:23 -0400 "Merge origin/main to reconcile force-pushed twin lineage"), and is the metadata's restored_lineage_twin_sha / rebuild target. issue.description:
ADR-004 requires a CI lane that compiles against the declared MSRV on every run, pinned to the same version as `rust-version` in Cargo.toml, with drift between the lane and the manifest treated as a CI failure. The declared 1.85 floor is currently 'true but untested', and the 2026-08-22 dependency refresh moved to caret ranges, so a compatible bump can silently raise the real floor. No open bead tracks this lane. Work: add the lane to the bead-rs-ci WorkflowTemplate in declarative-config and a guard that fails when the lane toolchain and the manifest version disagree.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
